tasks.title: Bootstrap Python project and repository layout
tasks.goal: Create the Python project foundation and canonical MATRIX repository structure.
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml defines the Python project and required development dependencies
app package structure matches the documented repository shape
tests directory contains unit, integration, and e2e locations
the project can be imported successfully
forbidden_changes: do not add unapproved major external dependencies

tasks.title: Configure linting, type checking, and Pytest
tasks.goal: Establish the mandatory static-analysis and automated-test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Ruff is configured and passes
type checking is configured and passes
Pytest is configured and can execute the test suite
forbidden_changes: do not replace the documented Python stack
do not disable checks simply to make the gate pass

tasks.title: Implement settings and structured logging foundation
tasks.goal: Provide centralized application settings and structured logging for subsequent MATRIX components.
acceptance_criteria: application settings load from environment configuration
safe defaults exist for local development
structured logging can be initialized by the application
unit tests cover settings behavior
forbidden_changes: do not introduce an alternate configuration platform

tasks.title: Create FastAPI application and liveness endpoint
tasks.goal: Create the FastAPI application foundation and documented liveness endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: FastAPI application starts successfully
GET /health/live returns a successful response
automated tests cover the liveness endpoint
forbidden_changes: do not introduce a second web service
do not add product APIs outside this task

tasks.title: Add Docker and Compose development baseline
tasks.goal: Provide the documented container baseline for local MATRIX development.
acceptance_criteria: Docker image builds successfully
Compose configuration is valid
containerized API can expose the liveness endpoint
forbidden_changes: do not introduce additional production services

tasks.title: Add continuous integration skeleton
tasks.goal: Create the initial CI gate for linting, type checking, tests, and the Phase 0 application baseline.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs Ruff
CI runs type checking
CI runs Pytest
CI fails when a required quality gate fails
forbidden_changes: do not store credentials in workflow files

notes: Initial Planner bootstrap for the Phase 0 repository-foundation milestone. Later V1 phases remain governed by docs/matrix_v1_architecture/11_IMPLEMENTATION_ORDER.md and will be expanded after the autonomous development loop is proven.
